test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My mother asked my father to increase her __personal use allowance__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"personal use allowance"** refers to a small amount of money given for minor personal expenses. (व्यक्तिगत उपयोग के लिए अनुदान) • **Example: **She used her personal use allowance to buy herself a new book and some stationery. • The term **"pin money"** historically referred to an allowance given to a woman by her husband for her personal expenses; it now generally means a small amount of money for minor expenses. (खुद के छोटे खर्चों के लिए दिया गया पैसा) • **Example: **Even though she had a job, her grandmother still liked to give her a little pin money when she visited. • Hence, we can infer that "personal use allowance" can be aptly substituted with "pin money". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Pell mell** (अव्यवस्थित रूप से): In a confused, rushed, or disorderly manner. • **Example:** The students rushed pell mell out of the classroom as soon as the bell rang. • **Rank and file** (साधारण सदस्य): The ordinary members of an organization as opposed to its leaders. • **Example:** The decision was not popular among the rank and file of the union. • **Pins and needles** (बेचैनी या घबराहट की अवस्था): A state of nervous anticipation. • **Example:** Waiting for the exam results had her on pins and needles. 40:Ta99, The correct answer is: **Approval**.
